item.description:
https://pixeldrain.com/u/eFXqLCqz

Pictures and setlist included. Still one of the high points of my life that I can refer back to in a slump to at least bring me to a higher baseline. Not the show so much as just the entire trip which was thrown together a little randomly based on a cheap one way found on Norse Atlantic. I am not the type to book a year in advance and hope I am still alive to do it.

Mick Rogers plays a slight almost imperceptible flourish from Visionary Mountains somewhere within. Anyone know if a full live version exists? During lockdown I was obsessed with this song.

Raw file was posted not long after which was tracked and posted to Dime by someone else.

Nothing will top 2025 but this was a really good one. Not paying attention to travel advisories means I miss the free T shirt and the first 2 pay to play openers. Was a little annoyed with one though I never wear them in public. Bobby from Pentagram watched a lot of L.A. Guns sidestage. Glad I got another shot at Armored Saint as I had a free ticket to the Glasshouse last year but I just couldn't get it together to go (very rare for me to not claim a freebie I was assigned). The cute guitar player with the short hair is no longer in Blaze Francisco. Kinda bummed because the music just doesn't do it for me but she is fun to watch because she is so into it.
